groups.sql: SELECT u.*, s.created_at AS session_created_at, s.last_seen_at AS session_last_seen_at FROM sessions s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash = ? AND s.created_at > ? AND COALESCE(s.last_seen_at, s.created_at) > ?
SELECT COUNT(*) completed, COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) gmv, COALESCE(SUM(commission), 0) commission, COALESCE(SUM(discount), 0) discounts FROM orders WHERE status IN ('completed','returned')
SELECT COUNT(*) count, COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) revenue FROM subscriptions WHERE activated_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 0 WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 1 WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 2 WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 3 WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 4 WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 5 WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 6 WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 7 WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 8 WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 9 WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 10 WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 11 WHEN completed_at < ? THEN 12 ELSE 13 END bucket, COALESCE(SUM(commission), 0) amount FROM orders WHERE status IN ('completed','returned') AND completed_at >= ? AND completed_at < ? GROUP BY bucket

SELECT CASE WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 0 WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 1 WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 2 WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 3 WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 4 WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 5 WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 6 WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 7 WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 8 WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 9 WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 10 WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 11 WHEN activated_at < ? THEN 12 ELSE 13 END bucket, COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) amount FROM subscriptions WHERE activated_at >= ? AND activated_at < ? GROUP BY bucket
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' AND ends_at > ?
SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM orders GROUP BY status
SELECT service, COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE status IN ('completed','returned') GROUP BY service
SELECT role, COUNT(*) n FROM users GROUP BY role
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM users WHERE role = 'driver' AND status = 'pending'
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'pending'
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM safety_incidents WHERE status = 'open'

SELECT u.*, s.created_at AS session_created_at, s.last_seen_at AS session_last_seen_at FROM sessions s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash = ? AND s.created_at > ? AND COALESCE(s.last_seen_at, s.created_at) > ?

SELECT * FROM users WHERE (? IS NULL OR role = ?) AND (name LIKE ? OR phone LIKE ? OR email LIKE ?) AND phone NOT LIKE 'deleted-%' AND phone NOT LIKE 'partner:%' ORDER BY status = 'pending' DESC, id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT AVG(rating) rating, AVG(price_rating) price_rating, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed','returned')) trips FROM orders WHERE driver_id = ?
